source_tree_hash_scheme: sha1('flight-commander-source-tree-v1\n' plus sorted sha256sum records, excluding RELEASE-MANIFEST.json)

bench_acceptance.workflow: select one enabled compass, complete its six-side learned orientation, then calibrate only that source's field offsets and gains
bench_acceptance.source_isolation: onboard, external I2C/UART GPS-module and DroneCAN GPS-module compasses retain independent transforms and field calibrations
bench_acceptance.fusion_gate: a magnetic source remains unavailable to heading fusion until both its own learned transform and field calibration are valid
bench_acceptance.propeller_requirement: propellers removed for all calibration and bench verification

dronecan_compass.node_capability: the source node is marked magnetometer-capable after either message decodes successfully

moving_baseline.module_family: Holybro DroneCAN H-RTK F9P / AP_Periph compatible
moving_baseline.configuration: one-stage remote parameter setup and verification
moving_baseline.dynamic_node_allocation: Flight Commander non-redundant DroneCAN allocator; temporary IDs are persisted to AP_Periph CAN_NODE during pair setup

slcan_bridge.protocol: LAWICEL/SLCAN over the requesting USB CDC serial port
slcan_bridge.bitrate_contract: The adapter retains the configured live DroneCAN bitrate and acknowledges S0-S8 only when the requested bitrate matches it.
slcan_bridge.entry_gate: Entry requires a disarmed aircraft and an online DroneCAN bus at 125, 250, 500 or 1000 kbit/s.
slcan_bridge.flight_safety: Bridge mode suspends normal Flight Commander DroneCAN processing and latches an arming-disable flag.
slcan_bridge.exit: Reboot the flight controller to exit bridge mode.

calibration_persistence.orientation_storage: saved automatically after an unambiguous six-position solve and reloaded on every boot
calibration_persistence.field_calibration_dependency: conventional offsets and gains are invalidated when the learned transform changes

driver_frame.scope: canonical IST8310 chip frame emitted by the driver

user_alignment.scope: saved installation/alignment layer applied after learned transform and field calibration

heading_source_liveness.driver_recovery: Retains the reviewed 4.0.4 75 ms conversion timeout and nonblocking IST8310 reset/reconfiguration path.
heading_source_liveness.freshness: sample age is independent from heading validity and field quality
heading_source_liveness.field_quality: fresh finite magnetic headings remain available at displayed quality 0; a one-percent authority floor keeps a single-source fused heading defined without concealing the warning or outweighing a better source
heading_source_liveness.startup_yaw: four consecutive fresh fused samples within 5 degrees seed yaw once while disarmed using a dedicated Flight Commander initialization state
heading_source_liveness.disabled_source_weight: reset, runtime migration and MSP writes normalize every disabled source weight to zero
heading_source_liveness.orientation_gate: onboard magnetic heading is unavailable to fusion until learned orientation and conventional field calibration are both valid
